items.title: Install State-Directed Engineering (SDE) v1.1.1 methodology inputs
items.description: Run npx @echelon-foundry/sde init to add the .sde/ methodology tree (18 managed files) alongside the ROS install.

items.title: Convert Strata design notebook into ROS requirements, decisions, experiments and work items
items.description: Phases 2-9: classify the pre-requirements notebook, challenge it, define minimum architecture and vertical slices, and publish ROS records plus backlog work items with traceability.

items.title: S1: Strata four-tier F# solution skeleton with mechanical architecture check
items.description: Create Strata.Semantic (netstandard2.0, FSharp.Core only), Strata.Analysis, Strata.Application, Strata.Host.Postgres, Strata.Host.PgParser, Strata.Cli and test projects. Add scripts/check-semantic-architecture.sh enforcing that Tier 1 references only FSharp.Core. Traces DF-STRATA-2026-D3F8, NFR-005.

items.title: S1: canonical semantic model for PostgreSQL schema objects
items.description: Tier 1 types for schemas, tables, columns, types, keys, constraints, indexes, views, routines, plus identity, provenance/evidence, categorical certainty, resolution state, managed-vs-observed scope and analysis completeness. Deliberately small per ER-014. Traces PR-006, PR-011, PR-014, PR-021, ER-008.

items.title: S1: PostgreSQL catalog introspection adapter
items.description: Tier 4 Npgsql adapter reading pg_catalog/information_schema into the canonical model, reporting per-category completeness including inaccessible metadata. Read-only, least privilege. Traces PR-004, PR-005, NFR-006, RK-004.

items.title: S1: deterministic semantic snapshot serialization
items.description: Deterministic, content-addressable JSON rendering of the semantic model with an explicit hand-written wire contract per Boundary Preservation. Traces PR-007, NFR-001, NFR-003, NFR-010.

items.title: S2: PostgreSQL parser adapter over pgsqlparser
items.description: Tier 4 adapter exposing a narrow DialectParser boundary (Parse, SplitStatements, Normalize, ParseRoutineBody, GetParserVersion, GetDialectVersion). Protobuf AST must not cross into Tier 1 or 2. Traces PR-001, PR-002, PR-003, DF-STRATA-2026-4C7A, ER-014.

items.title: S2: lexical scope resolution over the parse tree
items.description: Resolve CTE names, subquery aliases and table aliases into a scope chain before any reference becomes a dependency edge. Must not attribute a CTE-shadowed name to a real table. Traces PR-010, DF-STRATA-2026-9B2E, RK-001.

items.title: S2: reference extraction with explicit resolution states
items.description: Extract object and column references, classify each as resolved, partially-resolved, ambiguous, unsupported or unresolved; never collapse states. SELECT * must expand against a catalog snapshot or mark column analysis incomplete. Traces PR-009, PR-011, ER-008, RK-002.

items.title: S2: effect classification by consequence
items.description: Classify statements as read/insert/update/delete/merge/DDL/truncate/lock/routine-execution/dynamic/privilege/transaction-control/maintenance, capturing boundedness and data-loss possibility rather than statement type alone. Traces PR-015, ER-004.

items.title: S2: SQL corpus indexing with provenance
items.description: Index SQL units with source identifier, location, statement boundaries, content hash, dialect, parser version, parse status and extraction status. Traces PR-008, PR-014, NFR-002.

items.title: S3: dependency and relationship graph with evidence
items.description: Build declared edges from the catalog and observed edges from corpus join patterns, each carrying evidence count, sources and categorical certainty. Observed edges never become declared FKs. Traces PR-012, PR-013, ER-018, RK-017, HY-STRATA-2026-3C81.

items.title: S3: targeted retrieval queries and CLI output
items.description: Answer inspect/relationships/path/dependencies/readers/writers questions returning compact semantic slices with provenance and analysis scope, in JSON and human-readable form. Traces PR-016, PR-017, PR-021, ER-017, NG-010.

items.title: Spike B remainder: live-server binding comparison
items.description: Compare offline resolution against a live PostgreSQL server for search_path, overloaded functions, casts, operators, quoted identifiers, temp objects and ambiguous columns. Requires a PostgreSQL server, which was unavailable in the originating session. Resolves Q-005, Q-006, Q-027. Tests HY-STRATA-2026-4D92 and HY-STRATA-2026-5E03.
